response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, with notable contributions to developer tooling and open-source projects, but lacks demonstrable, recent, deep expertise in JVM ecosystems, Spring, or enterprise IDE tooling — key requirements for this role. His Java exposure is minimal and dated, with no evidence of working on IDE internals or JVM-based tooling in recent roles.
strengths: Strong track record in developer tooling and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Demonstrated ability to work across stacks and pick appropriate technologies for complex problems
Active educator and communicator with workshops on web internals, testing, and TDD
concerns: No recent or substantial experience with Java/Kotlin JVM tooling or enterprise frameworks like Spring
Minimal evidence of IDE internals, language server protocols, or build tool integration work
Java skills appear outdated and are not highlighted in recent roles, which focus on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
